subject: Quick 20-min walkthrough? Saw a usage uptick from BrightBridge
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 20-min walkthrough? Saw a usage uptick from BrightBridge

Hi Alex —

Congrats on the ramp this week — our telemetry flagged BrightBridge crossing the self-serve threshold (roughly 520k tokens in 48h). That often means teams hit a point where a short walkthrough uncovers quick wins (batching, prefix caching, routing to warm models) that cut cost and improve latency.

Would you be open to a focused 20-minute call this week to:
- Review what’s driving the spike
- Suggest a quick config or model variant to stabilize unit cost
- Answer any procurement/SLA questions you have

Slots I have open (PDT):
- Tue 7/25 11:00–11:20
- Tue 7/25 14:30–14:50
- Wed 7/26 10:00–10:20
(Or use: https://calendly.com/redwood/20min)

Attaching a short deck for context and a one-pager mutual action plan in case you want to loop in procurement.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0113

Attachments: redwood-briefing-slide-deck.pptx (pptx, 6 slides), mutual_action_plan.pdf (pdf, 1 page)

----
From: Alex Chen <alex@brightbridge.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: product@brightbridge.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 12:16:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Quick 20-min walkthrough? Saw a usage uptick from BrightBridge

Thanks Ben — appreciate the heads up. Yes, we did push a new prompt template and a couple of batch jobs which likely explain the spike. A 20-min overview sounds perfect.

Can we do Wed 7/26 17:00 CEST (which should be your 08:00 PDT)? Also quick Qs to prep:
- We’re evaluating a Dedicated pool for predictable throughput — can you cover the differences in cost/latency vs hosted?
- Any SOC 2/KMS notes we should include for procurement?

If that slot doesn’t work for you or Rishi, happy to pick another.

—Alex Chen
Head of Platform Integrations, BrightBridge
alex@brightbridge.ai

----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@brightbridge.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick 20-min walkthrough? Saw a usage uptick from BrightBridge

Thanks for the signal, Alex — welcome, and great to see you testing aggressive templates. Ben, thanks for the proactive outreach.

Alex — Wed 7/26 08:00 PDT works for me. To make the most of 20 minutes, propose a two-step cadence:
1) 20-min product walkthrough (Ben + me) to show quick ops levers (batching, prefix/KV caching, model routing) and cost-impact examples tailored to your observed token distribution.
2) Optional 30-min technical deep-dive with Marissa (our deployments lead) if you want to talk Dedicated capacity, end-to-end latency targets, and KMS auditability.

I’m attaching an internal runbook excerpt that outlines what we cover in the 30-min tech session — helps procurement and infra teams know what evidence they’ll see.

Two provisional deep-dive slots if you want both meetings back-to-back:
- Wed 7/26 08:30–09:00 PDT (back-to-back after 20-min)
- Thu 7/27 09:00–09:30 PDT

If you confirm Wed 08:00 PDT, I’ll have Ben drop a calendar invite and include the HubSpot deal. Deal ID: BB-2028-07-U1.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment referenced: runbook_deepdive_excerpt.pdf

----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Wed 7/26 08:00 PDT — Redwood 20-min walkthrough + optional deep dive

Perfect — Wed 7/26 08:00 PDT is on the books. I’ve included a short agenda and a single calendar link for both sessions; please accept the event that suits you.

Agenda (20-min):
- 5m: Intros and goals
- 10m: Observed usage drivers + quick config levers
- 5m: Next steps (deep dive, procurement docs)

Optional tech deep-dive follows (if accepted):
- 30m with Marissa: Dedicated capacity sizing, KV cache behavior, quantization tradeoffs, KMS/HSM options for Private deployment.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123_redwood_brightbridge
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/BB-2028-07-U1

Looking forward — I’ll drop the deck and MAD into the event notes. If you want anything specific covered in the deep-dive, reply-all with bullets and Marissa will prep.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
